comment: The only thing in this bundle that promotes a profile-map row from approximated to enforced.

A row here names, per rail, the rule in that rail's own artifact that carries the obligation. scripts/profile-map-gate.py opens the artifact and refuses a locator it cannot find, and it separately refuses an enforced row whose rail answers differently from the oracle on any vector citing the obligation. So a wrong entry here fails loudly, and an absent entry costs nothing but a weaker claim.

It is deliberately short. Every row was read against the condition text and the rule body before it was written, and a row nobody has read that way does not belong here. Growing it is review work, one obligation at a time, and the map is honest at every size.
Locators are rule names rather than line numbers. A line number in a file under active edit is wrong within a week, and it fails silently by pointing at whatever moved into the slot.
